data.title: Chat: favicon guard — a filter= presentation attribute (drop-shadow etc.) is a colour door T3/T4 do not read (AS-109 Ruben N4, test-only)

data.body: CONTEXT (filed by cto-owen from Ruben's AS-109 cycle-2 review, N4, tick watcher:57637 loop tick 23). Probe P3: filter="drop-shadow(0 0 1px red)" added as a presentation attribute on a favicon circle survives both the palette test (T3) and the SMIL test (T4) in api.test.js — all green. Same channel as the feColorMatrix note in AS-109's out-of-scope list, but needs no <filter> element, so it is an honest designer edit, not an adversarial one. BRANDING.md §7.A.5 already forbids shadows, so the ban is cheap and consistent with the brand: assert.ok(!/<filter[\s>]|\sfilter\s*=/i.test(artwork), ...) beside the existing style bans in T3 (or a sibling test so the count moves). Named falsifier (M4): P3 as line 6's circle gaining the attribute -> red naming filter; the unmutated favicon is the control (green). Test-only; favicon.svg untouched. Chat-set task, priority critical per the scheduling rule. Lattice's own out-of-scope siblings (feColorMatrix element, svg: namespace prefixes) stay out.

Planning stage opened (Owen, tick watcher:57637 loop tick 24). Third lane under WIP 3 beside the AS-124 (Ruben) and AS-125 (Priya) reviews. Picked as the next Chat-set critical by age with AS-103 still gated (no hooks block in .claude/settings.json). Plan: .lattice/plans/task_01M29MGDX4X5BDM4KHXP4N9J3G.md

Planned (cto-owen, tick watcher:57637 loop tick 24, on Opus under the Fable-limit fallback). Plan: .lattice/plans/task_01M29MGDX4X5BDM4KHXP4N9J3G.md. Branch feat/AS-126-favicon-filter-door from master 8e68358, worktree .worktrees/AS-126 added, branch linked. GROUND TRUTH (detached scratch of master, /tmp/AS-126-plan, removed after; the checkout untouched): host 613/611/0/2; compose via compose-run.mjs --project asc-plan-as126: 'Image asc-plan-as126-test Built', 613/605/0/8, leak check clean. Favicon subset 4 tests. The hole observed, not argued: line 6's circle given filter="drop-shadow(0 0 1px red)" is all green under master's api.test.js, and so is a <defs><filter><feColorMatrix/></filter></defs> + filter="url(#f)" on the path when the primitive carries no flood-color (Ruben's cycle-1 N3 P9 — closed here as a by-product; with flood-color="red" it was already red via T3's paint list). DECISION: a sibling test T5 ('api: AS-126 — the favicon carries no filter element or filter= attribute'), not an assertion inside T3 — the +1 count is the stale-image tell (parent §1, confirmed by Ruben at cycle 2) and gives the filter mutants a red set disjoint from T3/T4. Regex /<filter[\s\/>]|\sfilter\s*=/i with the <svg presence assert and a message naming the matched text. Measured under the candidate: drop-shadow attribute, <filter>+url(#f), FILTER=, spaced filter =, single-quoted filter='…', <FILTER> each red exactly {T5}; style="filter:…" and <style> stay {T3} with T5 green (narrow); color-interpolation-filters="linearRGB" GREEN (the false-positive question: decided no — the neighbours are '-' and 's'); filter= in the XML comment GREEN; unmutated favicon with T5 5/5 green. One recorded safe-direction false positive: ' filter=' inside an attribute VALUE (aria-label) reds T5 — the same property as T3's \sstyle\s*= ban since AS-28; recorded in the out-of-scope list, not fixed. Out of scope: mask=/clip-path=/opacity=/mix-blend-mode= (not colours; §6 asks Priya to probe one and file, not fold), svg: prefixes, entity encoding, <fe*> outside <filter> (inert). BATTERY: 13 runs full host suite on a detached scratch of the branch — M1 (P3) {T5}, M1-control green 613, M2 (<filter>+url) {T5}, M2-control green 613, M3 FILTER= / M4 spaced / M5 single-quoted {T5}, M6 style= {T3} T5 green, M7 color-interpolation-filters GREEN, M8 in-comment GREEN, R1 <set> {T4}, G1 flip !door {T5}, control green 614/612/0/2. 11 ACs. PREDICTED: host 614/612/0/2, favicon subset 5, compose 614/606/0/8 with the Built line. Test-only: api.test.js +~12 lines, favicon.svg byte-identical. SEAMS: AS-124 touches README/server.js/stream.test.js/watcher-events.test.js, AS-125 touches roster-truncation.test.js only — neither touches api.test.js or favicon.svg (verified); compose projects asc-impl-as126 / asc-review-as126. STAFFING: implementer Marcus (free — AS-125 is in Priya's hands; cold on this block; fallback Lena if AS-125 comes back to him first, plan unchanged); reviewer Priya (Ruben filed N4 and named the regex, so he cannot certify it — the AS-109 §6 mirror; Priya is on AS-125's review this tick and this nine-line review waits for her). Tasking messages hand over the plan, the branch, and each actor's own scratchpad only — never §3's red sets as observed results. Nothing committed; status untouched for the orchestrator (→ planned with --no-auto-review).
